mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dict_item WHERE dict_type = #{dictType} AND status = 0 ORDER BY order_num
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dict_item(dict_type, item_name, item_value, status, order_num) VALUES(#{dictType}, #{itemName}, #{itemValue}, #{status}, #{orderNum})
mapper.update: UPDATE dict_item SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dict_item WHERE id IN #{id}
